ThingDef.label: bloody mess
ThingDef.description: A pool of somebody that never happened: raw red tissue creeping like spilled viscera, budding half-organs that blink or clench once before being pulled back under. It is not an animal so much as an extension of the ground it sits on.

ThingDef.label: gawpsack
ThingDef.description: A drifting translucent bag stuffed with mismatched eyes, all of them open, all of them looking up. It reads the cloud from canopy height and sinks, all at once, seconds before the sky tears.

ThingDef.label: blisterfloat
ThingDef.description: A hanging cluster of taut skin blisters under a gas bladder, dragging weeping tendrils. It rides the storm updraft to escape and bursts in the sunlight, every time; the rim of the valley is littered with its husks.

ThingDef.label: scorchpod
ThingDef.description: A blistered walking seed-case on too few legs, shell sweating metal, smoking faintly the moment the light touches it. Gallium-based, not carbon — the one native that can walk into the Burn, and almost always cooks before it gets where it's going.

ThingDef.label: bloodlurk
ThingDef.description: A jointed shadow at the red waterline, all forelimb and siphon, that holds still better than anything alive should — until something warm comes to drink.

ThingDef.label: meltgut
ThingDef.description: A house-sized slug whose translucent belly shows the last three things it swallowed, at three stages of not existing any more. The valley's rendering vat: corrosive disposal of the Unfinished, faster than the goo reabsorbs.

ThingDef.label: sparkleech
ThingDef.description: A wet-winged flap of tissue with a socket-mouth that clamps onto an ocular tree and drinks its charge. The lights in its wings are stolen.

ThingDef.label: sparkleech grub
ThingDef.description: The same theft without the wings: a socket-mouthed grub working an ocular tree's roots low to the ground, in no hurry to grow into something that flies.

ThingDef.label: scaldhide
ThingDef.description: A low armoured slab of scar tissue on legs, plates fused wrong, that walks out into the killing light and eats what it finds already cooked.

ThingDef.label: doublemaw
ThingDef.description: Two jaws on one skull, the second set where a throat should be, taking turns. A fast omnivore on the carcass economy; its bite festers more often than it should.

ThingDef.label: gnashling
ThingDef.description: A fist of teeth with legs — mostly mouth, the rest an afterthought. Travels in numbers, strips what the doublemaw opens.

ThingDef.label: ikee
ThingDef.description: A shivering eye-cluster on legs that follows bigger things and watches. It lives off the goo's leavings and dives into the pockets when the light comes.

ThingDef.label: peeper
ThingDef.description: A once-predator gone soft and eye-studded — extra eyes opened in its hide until watching replaced hunting. A docile mid-tier browser of the goo margins, and another sky-reader the patient can learn from.

ThingDef.label: eyestinger
ThingDef.description: A big segmented thing whose raised tail ends not in a sting but in an eye — and it stings with it anyway. A heavy ambusher of the ocular groves.

ThingDef.label: fleshsop
ThingDef.description: A wet rag of a creature, barely holding a shape, that leans on things to stay standing. What an Unfinished looks like when the goo forgets to take it back — it needs to be loved to live another day.

ThingDef.label: skinflap
ThingDef.description: A sheet of loose wet skin that flies: no body to speak of, just the flap, slapping itself through the air between canopy layers and draping over branches to dry. It soaks spore-rich rain through its underside and drips. Harmless, numerous, and unforgettable.

ThingDef.label: gorekite
ThingDef.description: A stretched hide the size of a tent riding the storm shear, trailing one long wet grasper. Its shadow crossing yours is the only warning before it drops and smothers. It hunts everything caught in the open under the Bloom.

ThingDef.label: danglemaw
ThingDef.description: A mouth on a tendon: a muscular cord anchored in the Eyebark canopy with a free-hanging jaw at the end of it, slack until something walks underneath. Shelter from the sky under the trees is not safe from this.

ThingDef.label: crispling
ThingDef.description: A hunched picker crusted in its own char. It lets the Burn cook its back to a shell, then walks the scorch line eating what did not dive fast enough. The crust turns heat and light; the underside is soft.

ThingDef.label: sloshbelly
ThingDef.description: A tick the size of a dog, swollen tight with red water, its skin stretched to translucency. It sloshes audibly when it walks, and the natives puncture it to drink. It burrows shallow where the Burn passes.

ThingDef.label: ogleknot
ThingDef.description: A knot of mismatched eyeballs, no two the same size, carried high on a splay of stilt-thin tendril legs. It skitters through the red fog in quick jerks and stops dead to stare, every eye turning a different way at once. Nothing in it is meant to be eaten and nothing about it is meant to be looked at for long.
